job_post_list.title: Product Operation Manager - Trust and Safety
job_post_list.description:
About the team:
The T&S GenAI & Emerging Product team's mission is to empower the development of GenAI models and applications. We do this by building a world-class safety, testing, and risk management system that ensures GenAI innovations are launched responsibly.

Responsibilities
- Responsible for content safety operations for GenAI products
- [User operation] Manage the GenAI safety oncall process and goal, respond to user/customer/biz questions/feedback about online cases, provide short term solutions and route to Product if mid/long-term solution is needed
- [Data operation] Based on the online monitor, conduct leakage/overkill case analysis to determine whether they stem from strategy problems, model/safety model drift, policy issue, or new malicious practices
- [Enforcement operation] Execute rapid operational strategy adjustments after the case analysis. And drive product and policy teams to make strategy or rules adjustments if needed
- [Platform operation] Collect user feedback, measure platform performance and effectiveness, enable users to better adopt and utilize the platform, and support Product Managers in product planning, prioritization, and iterative improvements.
job_post_list.requirement:
Minimum Qualification(s)
- 5+ years of experience in operations.
- Strong interest in and solid understanding of AI technologies, including LLMs, VLMs, SFT, RLHF, DPO, RAG, multimodal AI, and embeddings.
- Data-driven with strong data sensitivity, able to quickly identify issues through data analysis, perform in-depth case analysis to locate root causes, drive effective problem resolution.

Preferred Qualification(s)
- Experience in AI product operations or safety strategy operations.
- Passionate about exploring AI agents and emerging AI tools to continuously improve operational efficiency and productivity.
- Goals-driven, with strong logical thinking and analytical skills, as well as excellent cross-functional communication, coordination, and execution abilities.

job_post_list.title: Category Creator Management Project Intern (TikTok Shop - US Operation) - 2026 Start (BS/MS)
job_post_list.description:
About the Team
The commerce industry has seen tremendous growth in recent years and has become a hotly contested space amongst leading Internet companies, and its future growth cannot be underestimated. We aim to bring discovery, inspiration, and joy back to shopping by making TikTok the commerce channel of choice for merchants, creators, and affiliates.

You've seen the virality and impact of #TikTokMadeMeBuyIt. Come join the team that is helping scale that phenomenon, and pioneer Content & Creator commerce in the US. We aim to bring discovery, inspiration, and joy back to shopping by making TikTok the leading, on-trend commerce platform of choice for brands, creators, and shoppers. We are an entrepreneurial team, passionate about shaping the future of shopping.

The TikTok Shop US operation team aims to deliver high quality products together with a unique customer experience via TikTok. The team is responsible for building the TikTok Ecommerce partnership for the TikTok e-commerce business in the US. With more than 1 billion loyal users globally, we believe TikTok is an ideal platform to deliver a brand new and better e-commerce experience to our users. We are looking for passionate and talented people to join us to build an e-commerce ecosystem that is innovative, secure and intuitive for our users together.

As a project intern, you will have the opportunity to engage in impactful short-term projects that provide you with a glimpse of professional real-world experience. You will gain practical skills through on-the-job learning in a fast-paced work environment and develop a deeper understanding of your career interests.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis - we encourage you to apply early.

Responsibilities:
- Support category teams in connecting priority products with suitable creators to help drive product discovery, content creation, and sales growth.
- Maintain and manage creator, product, merchant, campaign, and reporting trackers to support accurate day-to-day team operations.
- Support data processing and data maintenance across recurring reports, performance trackers, and business review materials.
- Help organize and manage creator pools, including creator segmentation, outreach follow-up, content progress tracking, and performance monitoring.
- Support ongoing creator campaigns and product sampling programs by coordinating operational details, tracking progress, and summarizing key blockers or opportunities.
- Assist with campaign operations and brand activations, including creator participation tracking, content readiness, incentive coordination, and post-campaign reporting.
- Support cross-functional initiatives and ongoing program operations by working with internal partners to track deliverables, follow up on open items, and maintain clear documentation.
- Prepare clear weekly summaries, campaign progress updates, performance notes, and action-oriented insights for team discussions and business reviews.
- Help improve repeatable workflows such as tracker maintenance, creator follow-up, reporting preparation, and stakeholder updates.
- Use productivity and analytical tools where appropriate to improve data organization, documentation quality, and operational efficiency.
job_post_list.requirement:
Minimum Qualifications:
- Currently enrolled in an undergraduate academic program or higher.
- Strong interest in e-commerce, creator economy, affiliate marketing, marketplace operations, category management, or digital marketing.
- Comfortable working with spreadsheets, trackers, dashboards, and structured data; able to organize information into clear summaries and action items.
- Strong attention to detail, especially when maintaining recurring reports, campaign trackers, creator lists, and operational status updates.
- Clear written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to summarize business context, progress, blockers, and next steps.
- High ownership and follow-through; able to manage multiple workstreams, ask questions early, and drive tasks forward in a fast-changing environment.
- Willingness to learn new tools, workflows, and business processes quickly.

Preferred Qualifications
- Prior experience in e-commerce, social commerce, creator marketing, influencer operations, affiliate marketing, marketplace operations, or business analytics.
- Experience with creator marketplace platforms, livestream commerce, paid media, campaign operations, or product sampling is a plus.
- Experience preparing business reports, weekly updates, campaign recaps, project trackers, or performance summaries.
- Familiarity with data analysis tools, business intelligence dashboards, or advanced spreadsheet workflows.
- Comfort using productivity tools for research, summarization, data organization, document drafting, or workflow automation.
- Cross-functional coordination and global team collaboration.

For TikTok
